declared_purpose: Prevent DeepSeek's 64k context overflow while preserving useful conversation information through compaction, relevance filtering, searchable archiving and optimization-event logging (SKILL.md:1-20,75-98,126-139). Archiving and logging are explicit features; default enablement, diagnostic excerpts and duplicated archival metadata are implementation choices.

data_operations.operation: Initialize embedding components and potentially obtain cached model artifacts
data_operations.data_scope: Model identifier Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and model artifacts; installation documentation describes an initial download and subsequent caching
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: @xenova/transformers pipelines; download recipient and cache location are unspecified
data_operations.condition: Optimizer initialization always requests a pipeline; archive initialization requests another when archiveIndexing is enabled. processMessages initializes again on every call.

data_operations.operation: Create archive directory and read or initialize its persistent index
data_operations.data_scope: Existing index entries, paths, metadata, keywords and archive statistics
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local optimizer memory and index.json under resolved archivePath; default ./context-archive
data_operations.condition: Archive enabled, which is the default. Any index read or parse failure triggers writing a new index.

data_operations.operation: Read, tokenize, compact and filter supplied conversation content
data_operations.source: Effective ContextOptimizer.processMessages and its compaction helpers
data_operations.data_scope: Message content, roles, priorities and timestamps; inferred duplication, verbosity and temporal characteristics
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: In-process optimizer and returned message array to its caller
data_operations.condition: The later processMessages definition is effective. It uses autoCompact, dynamicContext and optional archive retrieval; the earlier autoPrune implementation is superseded. Default compaction thresholds are 75% and 90%.

data_operations.source: Semantic compaction, relevance scoring and dynamic filtering
data_operations.data_scope: Full message content and currentQuery; vectors, similarity scores and priority-weighted relevance
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Embedding pipeline and in-process relevanceScores map; dependency-internal behavior is unresolved
data_operations.condition: Embedding model available. Semantic compaction embeds all supplied messages when at least three are present; query scoring combines similarity and priority. Dynamic filtering removes messages below the configured relevance threshold after decay.

data_operations.operation: Retain conversation and processing state in memory
data_operations.data_scope: Up to 100 processing-history records containing timestamps, message counts and token counts; relevance scores; lastQuery when query-aware compaction runs; wrapper conversation arrays
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Optimizer or wrapper instance memory; getContextPruner can retain an instance as a module singleton
data_operations.condition: During processing or wrapper addMessage calls. History records contain aggregate measurements rather than full messages; wrappers retain full messages.

data_operations.operation: Persist original compacted messages and derived search data
data_operations.data_scope: Original message content; role, priority, token count, storage and compaction times, reasons, strategies and compaction context; inferred category, keywords and optional embedding
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local archive entry JSON files and index.json; index duplicates metadata and keywords
data_operations.condition: Archive exists and compaction reports removed originals. Semantic merging records both originals. This moves content out of active context without deleting it from storage.

data_operations.operation: Search local archive and return ranked entries
data_operations.data_scope: Query keywords and optional embedding; each indexed entry's full JSON, including content, metadata and embedding; returned content, metadata, keywords and score
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local search component, then its caller; search counters remain in the index object and can be persisted by later index saves
data_operations.condition: Explicit search or retrieval. Entry files are read before category and age filters. All remaining candidates are scored before result limiting.

data_operations.operation: Extract bounded snippets and return source metadata
data_operations.data_scope: Selected archive sentences, estimated token counts, source identifiers, scores, coverage and complete source metadata
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Retrieval caller; no external transmission is implemented here
data_operations.condition: Archive available. Retrieval searches up to five results and budgets snippet text using maxContextTokens; returned metadata is outside that snippet budget.

data_operations.operation: Automatically reintroduce archive snippets into current context
data_operations.data_scope: Current query and messages for similarity checks; up to three deduplicated archive snippets with relevance annotations
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: System-role messages in the array returned to the caller
data_operations.condition: Archive enabled, query supplied, at least 10% context space available, query exceeds 20 tokens and no current message has similarity above 0.8. Retrieval uses minimum relevance 0.6 and a bounded snippet budget.

data_operations.operation: Write diagnostic content and optimization events
data_operations.source: Core processing, archive storage and default ContextOptimizerLogger
data_operations.data_scope: Current-query prefix up to 50 characters; archived-content prefix up to 80; archive-search query prefix up to 30; entry identifiers, categories, priorities, counts, scores, strategies, health and timing
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Process stdout through console.log; warning/error paths also emit messages to the console
data_operations.condition: Core processing and archive diagnostics are unconditional on chat logging settings. The default event handler checks logToChat and chatLogLevel. Its chat-send call is only a comment.

data_operations.operation: Pass event data to optional logging handlers
data_operations.data_scope: Event measurements and details; logArchiveSearch includes the full query in its handler payload
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Configured logger or callback; any downstream destination is unspecified
data_operations.condition: A custom logger or logger-level onLog is supplied. The optimizer does not forward its own options.onLog to the default logger. logToChat and chatLogLevel checks exist inside the default handler, not before custom handler invocation.

data_operations.operation: Pass role-labelled source text to an optional summarizer
data_operations.data_scope: Combined full content of the supplied message group, prefixed with message roles
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: config.summarizer callback; subsequent processing, transmission or persistence is unknown
data_operations.condition: summarizeGroup is explicitly invoked with a configured summarizer. No supplied normal compaction path calls this helper; temporal summarization uses local extractive summarization.

data_operations.operation: Read a local conversation file and persist processed output
data_operations.data_scope: Entire input JSON; message array; all other top-level fields when an object envelope is supplied; processed messages and output path
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: CLI memory, caller-selected output file and console diagnostics; normal optimizer processing can additionally write its archive
data_operations.condition: CLI prune command with input and output paths. Object-envelope fields are copied unchanged into output alongside processed messages.

data_operations.operation: Print demonstration data and retrieved excerpts
data_operations.data_scope: Packaged synthetic conversation/query examples, aggregate status, archive snippet prefixes up to 80 characters and current-message prefixes up to 60
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Process stdout; the simple integration demonstration also enables a local archive
data_operations.condition: Demonstration scripts are executed directly. These calls do not establish production chat disclosure.

data_operations.operation: Attempt archive deletion and reset local conversation buffers
data_operations.source: Archive cleanup/clear, wrapper clear and optimizer destroy
data_operations.data_scope: Indexed archive entry files and index records; wrapper conversation arrays; tokenizer resources
data_operations.condition: Size cleanup runs after storage exceeds archiveMaxSize, removing lower-priority and older entries toward 90% capacity. Explicit archive.clear attempts removal of indexed files. Failed unlink calls can leave files after index removal. Wrapper clear and optimizer destroy do not clear the archive; uninstall documentation separately instructs directory removal.

data_operations.operation: Attempt unavailable test and compatibility paths
data_operations.source: CLI test, legacy pruning helpers and example force-pruning method
data_operations.data_scope: Test operations are unspecified; compatibility calls receive supplied message arrays
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Referenced test module or missing methods; no downstream data operation is established
data_operations.condition: CLI test imports lib/index.test.js, absent from the supplied inventory. Compatibility helpers reference undefined WithArchive methods, and the Clawdbot example calls an undefined prune method.

potential_excess.data_scope: Raw query prefixes and original archived-content prefixes
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Process stdout from processMessages, ContextArchive.store and the default archive-search logger
potential_excess.condition: Processing receives a query, an original message is archived, or an archive-search event is logged. Core excerpts bypass chat logging settings.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Optimization-event logging is declared; copying conversation text into diagnostics is an implementation choice.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Report optimization actions, counts, strategies, health and retrieval scores.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Remove query/content excerpts from routine diagnostics and retain aggregate event details and entry identifiers.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep declared event logging and useful failure diagnostics; require explicit configuration if content-bearing debugging is needed.

potential_excess.data_scope: Full archive-search query in the event payload
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: ContextOptimizerLogger.onLog callback or equivalent supplied logger; further destinations are unknown
potential_excess.condition: logArchiveSearch is invoked, including successful automatic archive retrieval. Custom callback invocation is not gated by the default handler's logging checks.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Search-event reporting needs outcome measurements; full query text is additional data in that event.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Report snippet count and similarity while supporting configured logging controls.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Omit the query from routine callback payloads and make content-bearing payloads an explicit option.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain event type, result count and similarity; allow explicit query access for handlers whose intended function requires it.

potential_excess.data_scope: Repeated temporal summaries and extracted text inside compactionContext
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Each archived original's metadata in its entry JSON and another copy in index.json
potential_excess.condition: Temporal or extractive compaction records summary/extraction text in removal context, which storeRemovedInArchive copies into metadata.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Searchable storage of compacted originals is explicit. Repeating derived conversation text in every metadata record is extra data within the required storage action.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Preserve original content, search vectors/keywords and sufficient source, priority and timing metadata.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Exclude summary/extraction text from compactionContext or store one shared derivation reference; keep index metadata free of duplicated conversation text.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain original archived content and fields used for ranking, category filtering, cleanup and source identification.

potential_excess.data_scope: Complete source metadata, potentially including whole temporal summaries or extractions beyond selected snippets
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: retrieveRelevantInfo caller through sources[].metadata; this is a caller return, not an established remote disclosure
potential_excess.condition: Retrieved entries have content-bearing compactionContext metadata. maxContextTokens budgets snippet text only.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The declared retrieval goal is selective loading of relevant snippets.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Return relevant snippets within budget with enough information to identify and assess their sources.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Return a source-metadata allowlist and omit summary/extraction payloads; budget any intentionally returned additional text.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep source identifiers, scores, snippet counts and required attribution fields.

potential_excess.data_scope: Full archive files belonging to excluded categories or outside the requested age range
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local ContextArchive.search memory through fs.readFile and JSON.parse
potential_excess.condition: Explicit search supplies category/timeRange filters that exclude entries. The current implementation reads files before applying those filters.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Search must rank eligible candidates; reading already-excludable files is a redundant local read.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Filter candidates and rank matching entries using keywords and available embeddings.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Apply category and timestamp filters using existing index metadata before reading entry files.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Use equivalent filter semantics and keep index metadata consistent; read all eligible candidates needed for ranking.

potential_excess.data_scope: Existing archive index, including keywords and content-bearing metadata, plus embedding-model initialization
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: CLI optimizer/archive memory and embedding components
potential_excess.condition: CLI status or stats initializes the optimizer before dispatch even though those commands only print current counters/configuration and do not display archive data.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: These commands report status and statistics; archive-content loading is a redundant initialization action for their implemented outputs.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Construct and print the requested status or statistics.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Initialize archive and embedding components only for commands that use them.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve the implemented status/statistics output and initialize fully before prune or future archive-aware commands.

unknowns: Dependency implementations are not supplied. Model-download endpoints, request metadata, cache paths, telemetry and dependency-internal handling of text cannot be determined. Packaged code establishes pipeline calls, not conversation disclosure to DeepSeek or another remote service.
Custom summarizer and logging-handler implementations are absent. Their downstream recipients, persistence and deletion behavior remain unresolved; the default logger implements console output only.

The supplied inventory lacks lib/index.test.js and the compatibility methods referenced by legacy/example paths. Their intended downstream operations cannot be audited; packaged execution would encounter missing-module or missing-method failures.
Console capture, caller persistence and filesystem backups are outside the supplied source. Unlink attempts and index resets do not establish removal from those locations.
